title: Self-Locking Arbiter State (Missing Else Branch)
bug_signature: UVM_FATAL: [DEADLOCK] FSM stuck in IDLE with req[1]=1; Master 1 never granted
expected_root_cause: The next-state combinational logic handles req[0] going to GNT0 but has no else-if branch for req[1]; when only master 1 requests, the FSM stays in IDLE indefinitely and master 1 is never served.
expected_fix_contains: else if (state == IDLE && req[1]) next_state = GNT1
description: The next-state logic for GNT0 has no else branch, so when req[0] is low and req[1] is high the FSM stays in IDLE indefinitely instead of transitioning to GNT1.
failure_log: UVM_FATAL: [DEADLOCK] FSM stuck in IDLE with req[1]=1; Master 1 never granted
success_log: Master 1 granted within 2 cycles of asserting req[1].
